descriptions.inProgress: #p2111000# asked me to search Dr. De Lang's house, and if I find any information inside, I have to report it to him. I better head off to the missing alchemist's house.
descriptions.completed: There were some writings found at the missing alchemist's house, but nothing seems significant. It did mention a pendant multiple times, though... a pendant? What does that have to do with his studies?
